scripts.tag: git tag v$(node -p "require('./packages/core/package.json').version") && git push origin v$(node -p "require('./packages/core/package.json').version")
scripts.release:patch: pnpm version:patch && pnpm publish:all && pnpm tag
scripts.release:minor: pnpm version:minor && pnpm publish:all && pnpm tag
scripts.release:major: pnpm version:major && pnpm publish:all && pnpm tag
